ai.title: Add chip tier and downlink fields to ad client context
ai.summary: The ad client context schema in the common package gains two optional training features under COD-883: a `cpuTier` enum in the `sys` object and a downlink enum in the `net` object. The `cpuTier` field maps the local CPU model string to a coarse tier using the new `cpuTierOf` function, while downlink buckets estimated bandwidth via `bucketDownlink`. In the CLI, the `systemSection` helper now calls `cpuTierOf` on the cached CPU model to populate the new `cpuTier` field. These fields are additive and optional, so the context version remains 1 and no client-server skew breaks existing requests.
ai.evidence: The diff adds `CPU_TIERS` and `DOWNLINK_BUCKETS` constants, the `cpuTierOf` and `bucketDownlink` functions, and the `cpuTier`/downlink schema fields in `common/src/types/ad-client-context.ts`, while `cli/src/ads/ad-client-context.ts` imports `cpuTierOf` and populates the `cpuTier` field in the `systemSection` helper.
